comments.content:
VERIFY-OR-BLOCK measurement (2026-08-31, production-at-claim; no .moe records read or edited):

1. Repo-owned search:
`$terms=@('complete_task','task.verification','completionSummary','reviewSummary'); foreach($term in $terms){ git grep -n -I -F $term -- 'apps/**' 'packages/**' 'adapters/**' 'tests/**' 'tools/**' 'scripts/**'; if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 1){'NO_MATCHES'} }`
returned NO_MATCHES for all four terms in D:/projexts/moe-next. A Task type/schema scan over the same tracked scopes also returned NO_MATCHES. The workspace manifests/lock have no Moe workforce daemon dependency.

2. Actual served authority is external. The running JetBrains Moe proxy launches the installed `moe-daemon` for `--project D:/projexts/moe-next`; its repository identifies Moe-s-Tavern. Source checkout `D:/projexts/moes` is a separate git root (HEAD 5b5784e4be6709b0401a877f1038ea4760a93fe6), and its built modules match the installed plugin bytes for the measured boundary.

External production path/call chain:
- `packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/completeTask.ts`: complete_task input schema, calls validator, stamps reportedAt, writes task.verification.
- `packages/moe-daemon/src/util/enforcement.ts::assertVerificationEvidence`: current admission/normalization codec.
- `packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts::TaskVerification`: durable record type.
- `packages/moe-daemon/src/state/taskStore.ts::updateTask` -> `state/persistence.ts::writeEntity` -> `util/atomicWrite.ts::atomicWriteJsonAsync`: durable persistence.
- `packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getContext.ts`: real reader; returns full current-task verification and reduced declared-dependency verification.
- Served consumer edge: `src/index.ts` -> `server/McpAdapter.ts` -> `tools/index.ts`, which registers/dispatches completeTaskTool and getContextTool.

Current contract admits any nonblank trimmed command <=500 plus integer exitCode=0 and optional string outputTail (suffix-truncated at 2000). It has no explicit cwd/executable/argv and no prose, placeholder, shell-chain, or vanished-temp screening. Current provenance is only MISSING_REQUIRED or INVALID_INPUT; no recipe-specific stable code/layer exists.

A platform repair can be bounded in that external repo (writer/validator/type/reader/persistence and focused tests), but this moe-next row has zero legal implementation paths. Per DoD 1 and the task rail, submitting a local plan would fabricate the authority. needsFrom=platform/governor: authorize/rehome the writer-contract repair in the Moe-s-Tavern project and assign its exact external path roster; keep historical records immutable and do not migrate .moe data.
